description: This file defines a React component 'FluidPanels' that manages a swipeable, animated panel interface with drawer functionality, including gesture handling, navigation, and state management for a mobile app.

classes.name: TabsRef
classes.description: Interface defining methods and properties for controlling the FluidPanels component externally.

methods.name: goToPage
methods.description: Navigate to a specified page ('home' or 'editor') with optional animation.

methods.name: goToIndex
methods.description: Navigate to a specific index (0 for drawer, 1 for home, 2 for editor) with optional animation.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the drawer lock, allowing user interaction.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the drawer, preventing user interaction.

methods.name: openDrawer
methods.description: Opens the drawer with optional animation.

methods.name: closeDrawer
methods.description: Closes the drawer with optional animation.

methods.name: isDrawerOpen
methods.description: Returns whether the drawer is open.

methods.name: node
methods.description: Ref to the animated view container.

methods.name: tabChangedFromSwipeAction
methods.description: Shared value indicating if the tab change was triggered by a swipe gesture.
